errors.text_span: The x-axis represents the layer number and is scaled linearly from 1 to 32, with tick labels indicating Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32.
errors.evidence: The x-axis is a categorical axis representing groups of layers, not a linear scale from 1 to 32.

errors.text_span: with tick marks spaced every 1% increment
errors.evidence: The y-axis has major tick marks and grid lines spaced every 5%, not 1%.

errors.text_span: a minimum value of -6% at Layer13-20
errors.evidence: For the orange (LB-Avg of 2xtokens, 8-bit) line, the minimum value is approximately -1% at Layer5-12. The value -6% corresponds to the light blue line.
The red line (LB-Avg of 1xtokens, 16-bit) is represented by square markers, not circular markers.

errors.text_span: a minimum value of -9% at Layer13-20
errors.evidence: For the red (LB-Avg of 1xtokens, 16-bit) line, the minimum value is approximately -2.5% at Layer21-28. The value -9% does not appear on this line.
For the light blue (RULER4k of 2xtokens, 8-bit) line, the minimum value at Layer13-20 is approximately -6%, not -12%.
The fourth line (RULER4k of 1xtokens, 16-bit) is dark blue, not teal. 'Teal' or light blue is the color of the third line.
The fourth line (RULER4k of 1xtokens, 16-bit) is represented by solid square markers. The baseline is a dashed line, but the markers for this data series are not dashed.
The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1xtokens, 16-bit) is not consistent; it varies significantly from about -1.5% down to -14.5%.
For the dark blue (RULER4k of 1xtokens, 16-bit) line, the minimum value at Layer13-20 is approximately -14.5%, not -10%.
The orange line stays very close to the 0% baseline, with values between approximately -1% and 0.5%. '-2%' is an inaccurate description of its position.

errors.text_span: a maximum value of -2% at Layer1-4
errors.evidence: The maximum value for the orange line is slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The value at Layer1-4 is just below 0%. -2% is incorrect.

errors.text_span: a maximum value of -3% at Layer1-4
errors.evidence: The maximum value for the red line is 0% at Layer1-4, not -3%.
The maximum value for the dark blue line is at Layer1-4 and Layer29-32, at approximately -1.5%, not -4%.
